images.label: Le rugby
images.prompt: Create exactly one landscape 4:3 illustration, native size 1448x1086 if supported. Match approved reference images: semi-realistic hand-painted digital educational illustration, softly modeled volumes, fine discreet contours, warm natural colours, subtle painterly texture. No thick black cartoon outlines, no 3D render or photorealism. Subject: On a rugby pitch, two adult women playing touch rugby. Foreground woman medium brown skin, short curly black hair, athletic stocky build, green rugby jersey and black shorts running holding a clearly OVAL rugby ball in two hands. Second woman lighter olive skin, short auburn hair, blue jersey in natural defensive stance without contact. Clear rugby H shaped goalposts in background, no net, no helmets, no numbers or lettering. Entire anatomically correct people visible, distinct new faces, natural inclusive sports scene.
